## 🤖 Claude *(13:02:03)*

Found a real bug — exactly the class the briefing warned about. The 45-char word runs **off the right edge, clipped**, while my box-based probe reported "INSIDE" (the box lies; the glyphs overflow it). `overflow-wrap:anywhere` doesn't shrink an inline-block's min-content in Chromium.

  "new_string": "  layoutBeat(beatEl, st);\n  SPANS=beatEl.getElementsByClassName('w');\n  CUR=idx;\n}\n\n// Converging layout: try a size \u2192 lock the word boxes at that size \u2192 measure the LOCKED block.\n// Locking can add a line (an oversized word gets clamped and hard-broken), so the height must be\n// re-measured after locking, never before. Deterministic: driven only by content + the size ladder.\nfunction layoutBeat(beatEl, st){\n  var stage=document.getElementById('stage');\n  var maxH=(stage.clientHeight||460)-25;   // budget excludes the hairline row\n  var size=st.base;\n  for(;;){\n    beatEl.style.fontSize=size+'px';\n    unlockWidths(beatEl);\n    lockWidths(beatEl);\n    if(beatEl.scrollHeight<=maxH || size<=MIN_FONT_PX) break;\n    size-=2;\n  }\n  // Still overflowing at the floor \u2192 drop trailing words and mark the cut (Lei 1: mutilation must be visible).\n  var guard=0;\n  while(beatEl.scrollHeight>maxH && beatEl.childNodes.length>1 && guard<400){\n    beatEl.removeChild(beatEl.lastChild);\n    var last=beatEl.lastChild;\n    if(last){\n      last.textContent=last.textContent.replace(/\u2026$/,'')+'\u2026';\n      unlockWidths(beatEl); lockWidths(beatEl);\n    }\n    guard++;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction unlockWidths(beatEl){\n  var els=beatEl.getElementsByClassName('w');\n  for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){\n    els[i].style.width=''; els[i].style.whiteSpace=''; els[i].style.wordBreak='';\n  }\n}"

## 🤖 Claude *(13:03:41)*


## 🤖 Claude *(13:03:42)*

Found it: the span *internally wrapped* while being measured, so the measured width was a lie — then `nowrap` forced it back onto one line, overflowing its own locked box. Measuring must happen **with nowrap already applied**.
